data.desc: Skye Bioscience, Inc. (Nasdaq: SKYE) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company. Its lead program has been nimacimab, a negative allosteric modulating antibody that peripherally inhibits the CB1 receptor, developed for weight loss in patients with obesity or overweight and evaluated in the CBeyond Phase 2a trial. Additional information is contained in Skye's periodic reports filed with the SEC. For more information, visit www.skyebioscience.com.
